cases.desc: Verify Home screen shows illustration, headline, six tiles and Login button.
cases.expected: Illustration, 3-line headline, six tiles (3 + 3) and one Login button are shown on blue background; no Register Now, chatbot or accessibility icon.
cases.approach: unit-testable - screen paints the page with #035795 (token), shows the exact 3-line headline, six tiles in rows of three and Login, and has no Register Now, chatbot or accessibility icon

cases.desc: Verify tile labels and order.
cases.expected: Order is Pay Now, Our Products, Track Application, FAQs, Offers, Contact Us with exact label capitalisation.
cases.approach: unit-testable - tile labels and order asserted as exactly Pay Now, Our Products, Track Application, FAQs, Offers, Contact Us, then Login

cases.desc: Verify Home screen loads without waiting for background calls.
cases.expected: Home is drawn and tappable immediately; no blocking loader.
cases.approach: unit-testable - with the token and the version call both pending, Home shows no loader and no dialog and Login still navigates; token requested once on mount

cases.desc: Verify Pay Now action opens the payment portal.
cases.expected: WebView opens the configured payment portal URL with title Pay Now.
cases.approach: unit-testable - divergent: case expects a WebView opening the payment portal; plan-stage owner decision 2026-11-06 (O-05, FR-014) opens a Pay Now screen with header "Pay Now" and a back button only, no WebView

cases.desc: Verify Our Products action routes to Products.
cases.expected: Products screen opens.
cases.approach: unit-testable - Our Products tile navigates to Products

cases.desc: Verify Track Application action routes to its destination.
cases.expected: User is taken to the Track Application destination (destination pending confirmation, BRD O-03).
cases.approach: unit-testable - Track Application tile navigates to TrackApplication (O-03 resolved in the spec: separate flow, Home owns only the hand-off)

cases.desc: Verify FAQs action opens FAQ screen.
cases.expected: FAQ screen opens with the FAQ list.
cases.approach: unit-testable - FAQs tap opens the Faq route and stores the fetched list

cases.desc: Verify Offers action routes to non-logged Offers.
cases.expected: Offers (non-logged) screen opens.
cases.approach: unit-testable - Offers tile navigates to Offers

cases.desc: Verify Contact Us action opens the Customer Care popup.
cases.expected: Popup "We are here to help!" opens over Home.
cases.approach: unit-testable - Contact Us tap shows "We are here to help!" over Home with no route change

cases.desc: Verify Login button routes to Login screen.
cases.expected: Login screen opens.
cases.approach: unit-testable - Login press records cta_clicked then navigates to LoginScreen

cases.desc: Verify FAQ action fetches content when cache is not available.
cases.expected: Spinner shows, FAQ API is called and FAQ screen opens with response data.
cases.approach: unit-testable - no cache: spinner shows, fetchFaq called once, list stored and Faq opens

cases.desc: Verify FAQ action uses cached content when available.
cases.expected: FAQ screen opens immediately from cache with no new API call.
cases.approach: unit-testable - cached list opens Faq at once with no request and no spinner

cases.desc: Verify user returns to Home after closing the Pay Now WebView.
cases.expected: User returns to Home safely.
cases.approach: unit-testable - divergent: case expects a return from the Pay Now WebView; the built Pay Now screen has no WebView, only a back button that returns to Home (FR-014)

cases.desc: Verify FAQ API failure with no cache shows error.
cases.expected: Spinner closes and error dialog shows: Your request could not be processed at this moment. Request you to try again after sometime. User stays on Home.
cases.approach: unit-testable - FAQ failure clears the spinner, shows the exact error dialog and keeps the user on Home

cases.desc: Verify Pay Now URL unavailable is handled.
cases.expected: No crash; WebView error or fallback is shown and user can return to Home.
cases.approach: unit-testable - divergent: case expects a WebView error or fallback for an unavailable portal URL; the spec decision shows no web content, loader or error state on Pay Now (FR-014)

cases.desc: Verify stale session flags are reset on Home entry.
cases.expected: Non-logged route flags are reset and Home behaves as a fresh visitor.
cases.approach: unit-testable - on focus the offers form, selected offer and register return flag are reset (FR-062 to FR-064 define the reset set)

cases.desc: Verify Home works when non-logged token generation succeeds.
cases.expected: All quick actions remain accessible.
cases.approach: unit-testable - after a successful token request all six tiles and Login are present, not disabled and a tile still navigates

cases.desc: Verify token generation failure is handled silently.
cases.expected: No error shown; Home stays stable and usable (BRD NLH-E01). A later FAQ call may show its own error dialog.
cases.approach: unit-testable - token failure is swallowed: no dialog, no Okay button, no loader, seven buttons remain; service resolves quietly for every failure

cases.desc: Verify no dialog when app version is up to date.
cases.expected: No dialog; Home usable.
cases.approach: unit-testable - an up-to-date version classifies as none and the dialog renders nothing for none

cases.desc: Verify maintenance dialog is shown.
cases.expected: Blocking dialog shows the server message with Exit button (Android); cannot be dismissed.
cases.approach: unit-testable - maintenance shows the server message with only Exit on Android, is not dismissed by back, and is classified with the server message

cases.desc: Verify mandatory update dialog.
cases.expected: Blocking dialog "Update your app to experience all the latest features." with Update and Exit; cannot be dismissed.
cases.approach: unit-testable - mandatory shows the exact update text with Update and Exit, cannot be dismissed

cases.desc: Verify Update button opens the store link.
cases.expected: Play Store (Android) or App Store (iOS) opens target_url.
cases.approach: unit-testable - Update hands target_url to Linking.openURL (the store app itself is the OS)

cases.desc: Verify optional update dialog can be dismissed.
cases.expected: Dismissable dialog shows; Home usable after dismiss.
cases.approach: unit-testable - optional shows Update and Skip; Skip and back dismiss it and the outcome returns to none

cases.desc: Verify update is not enforced when status is not Active.
cases.expected: No dialog is shown.
cases.approach: unit-testable - an update is enforced only when status is Active; Inactive and lowercase active give none

cases.desc: Verify version 1.8.10 is treated newer than 1.8.9.
cases.expected: Mandatory update dialog is shown (numeric part-by-part compare).
cases.approach: unit-testable - 1.8.10 compares newer than 1.8.9 numerically and classifies as mandatory

cases.desc: Verify 401 from version service shows message and logs out.
cases.expected: Server message shows with Okay; on Okay the logout call runs.
cases.approach: unit-testable - divergent: case expects the server message with "Okay" and a logout on Okay for a 401; spec FR-055 decision shows no popup and clears the logged-in token silently

cases.desc: Verify version call failure or empty body fails open.
cases.expected: No dialog; Home usable.
cases.approach: unit-testable - a thrown version call and null, empty or malformed bodies resolve to none (fail open)

cases.desc: Verify version request sends capitalised platform value.
cases.expected: user_agent is exactly Android or iOS (capitalised) and version is the installed version.
cases.approach: unit-testable - version request posts the installed version with user_agent exactly Android or iOS

cases.desc: Verify iOS has no Exit button on blocking dialogs.
cases.expected: Only Update is available; no Exit; dialog cannot be dismissed.
cases.approach: unit-testable - on iOS the mandatory dialog shows only Update and the maintenance dialog shows no button; neither is dismissed by back

cases.desc: Verify blocking dialog cannot be dismissed by Android back.
cases.expected: Dialog stays open; app is not exited and Home is not reachable.
cases.approach: unit-testable - Android back on a blocking dialog calls no handler and the back event is consumed so the app does not exit

cases.desc: Verify exit confirmation shows on Android back.
cases.expected: Dialog "Are you sure you want to exit!" with CANCEL and Okay shows.
cases.approach: unit-testable - Android back with nothing open shows "Are you sure you want to exit!" with CANCEL and Okay

cases.desc: Verify Okay on exit dialog closes the app.
cases.expected: App exits.
cases.approach: unit-testable - Okay on the exit dialog calls BackHandler.exitApp once

cases.desc: Verify CANCEL on exit dialog keeps user on Home.
cases.expected: Dialog closes; user stays on Home.
cases.approach: unit-testable - CANCEL closes the dialog without exiting and Home stays

cases.desc: Verify back closes Contact Us popup before exit dialog.
cases.expected: First back closes popup only; second back shows exit dialog.
cases.approach: unit-testable - first back closes the popup only; the next back shows the exit dialog

cases.desc: Verify FAQ back returns to Home.
cases.expected: Home screen is shown.
cases.approach: unit-testable - partial: the FAQ back flag faqsFromNonLogin is true on the cache path and the fetch path and the reset runs when Home regains focus; blocked: FAQ screen module (not in this repo) that reads the flag and navigates back

cases.desc: Verify offers form data is cleared on return to Home.
cases.expected: Offers fields are empty.
cases.scenario: State reset when Home regains focus
cases.approach: unit-testable - focus resets the offers form to empty fullName, mobileNo and tncAccepted false

cases.desc: Verify selected pre-approved offer is cleared on return to Home.
cases.expected: Selected offer is cleared.
cases.scenario: State reset when Home regains focus
cases.approach: unit-testable - focus clears the selected pre-approved offer

cases.desc: Verify register return flag is cleared on return to Home.
cases.expected: Register CIF field is not pre-filled or locked from the stale origin.
cases.scenario: State reset when Home regains focus
cases.approach: unit-testable - partial: registerNowReturnScreen is null after focus; blocked: Register Now module (not in this repo) whose CIF field must not be locked by a stale origin

cases.desc: Verify Offers fail screen Ok returns to Home with reset state.
cases.expected: Home shows and offers state is reset.
cases.scenario: State reset when Home regains focus
cases.approach: unit-testable - the reset runs on every later focus (Offers back, Offers fail Ok, FAQ back) and leaves the offers state empty each time

cases.desc: Verify focus reset does not clear FAQ cache or token.
cases.expected: FAQ opens from cache; token still used on requests.
cases.scenario: State reset when Home regains focus
cases.approach: unit-testable - the focus reset leaves the FAQ cache and the non-logged token in the store

cases.desc: Verify popup heading and three rows.
cases.expected: Heading We are here to help!; rows Call Us 022-45297300, Email Us bhflwecare@bajajhousing.co.in, Find Us Branch locator.
cases.approach: unit-testable - popup shows the heading and the three rows with their exact details

cases.desc: Verify popup closes with its close control.
cases.expected: Popup closes and Home is shown.
cases.approach: unit-testable - the close control, outside tap and Android back all call onClose; on Home the popup text disappears

cases.desc: Verify focus returns to Contact Us tile after closing popup.
cases.expected: Focus returns to the Contact Us tile.
cases.approach: unit-testable - partial: closing the popup calls setAccessibilityFocus with the node held by the Contact Us tile ref; manual remainder: a person confirms with TalkBack and VoiceOver that focus lands on the tile

cases.desc: Verify popup scrolls at large text sizes.
cases.expected: Popup height is capped, content scrolls inside, nothing clipped.
cases.approach: unit-testable - partial: card maxHeight is exactly window height minus insets minus 64 (576 at 640) at 2x font scale, content sits in a ScrollView and no Text has a fixed height; manual remainder: a person confirms nothing is clipped on a real device at large text

cases.desc: Verify Call, Email and Find Us tap behaviour.
cases.expected: Dialer, mail app and branch locator open as confirmed (BRD O-06, behaviour pending).
cases.approach: unit-testable - Call Us opens tel:02245297300, Email Us opens mailto:bhflwecare@bajajhousing.co.in, Find Us navigates to BranchLocator; popup closes each time

cases.desc: Verify popup opens only once on rapid taps.
cases.expected: Only one popup instance opens.
cases.approach: unit-testable - three rapid Contact Us taps leave exactly one popup

cases.desc: Verify Bearer token is sent on FAQ request.
cases.expected: Authorization: Bearer token plus app-version, platform and device-details headers are present.
cases.approach: unit-testable - FAQ request carries Authorization Bearer token plus app-version, platform and device-details headers

cases.desc: Verify token request times out after 10 seconds.
cases.expected: Request aborts at 10 s with no UI error; Home usable.
cases.approach: unit-testable - token request is sent with a 10000 ms timeout and a timeout error resolves quietly; Home stays usable

cases.desc: Verify early FAQ tap waits for in-flight token.
cases.expected: FAQ request waits for the token and succeeds without 401.
cases.approach: unit-testable - a call made while the token request is in flight waits and then carries the late Bearer token

cases.desc: Verify relaunch after 15 minutes uses a fresh non-logged token.
cases.expected: New non-logged token is generated; stale logged-in token is not used.
cases.approach: unit-testable - a logged-in token is never returned as the non-logged token and a fresh one is requested

cases.desc: Verify FAQ shows error after token failure.
cases.expected: FAQ request fails and error dialog shows.
cases.approach: unit-testable - token request rejected, FAQ call still made once and its failure shows the error dialog

cases.desc: Verify token request body fields are encrypted.
cases.expected: username and password are encrypted, not plain text; no credentials in release logs.
cases.approach: unit-testable - username and password are sent only as encrypted values, and no console method receives a credential or the token

cases.desc: Verify token is stored after success.
cases.expected: Token held in memory and in encrypted storage key auth_token_Nonlogged.
cases.approach: unit-testable - token is held in the store and under storage key auth_token_Nonlogged

cases.desc: Verify empty FAQ list keeps user on Home with no dialog.
cases.expected: Spinner closes; user stays on Home; no dialog.
cases.approach: unit-testable - an empty list stays on Home with no dialog and the spinner cleared

cases.desc: Verify non-array FAQ response does not crash.
cases.expected: Treated as empty; no crash; stays on Home.
cases.approach: unit-testable - every non-array FAQ body resolves to an empty list, so Home stays with no crash

cases.desc: Verify double tap on FAQs sends one request.
cases.expected: Only one FAQ request is made.
cases.approach: unit-testable - three FAQs taps while loading send one request

cases.desc: Verify spinner blocks other touches while FAQ loads.
cases.expected: Touches are blocked until the spinner closes.
cases.approach: unit-testable - partial: the loading overlay is a modal, announced layer, swallows Android back and further FAQs taps send no second request; manual remainder: a person confirms on a device that taps outside the spinner are blocked

cases.desc: Verify retry after FAQ failure succeeds.
cases.expected: FAQ screen opens on second attempt.
cases.approach: unit-testable - after a failure and Okay a second tap fetches again and opens Faq

cases.desc: Verify Okay on FAQ error dialog keeps user on Home.
cases.expected: Dialog closes; user remains on Home.
cases.approach: unit-testable - Okay closes the FAQ error dialog, no navigation happens and Login is still shown

cases.desc: Verify spinner always clears on FAQ failure or timeout.
cases.expected: Spinner clears and error dialog shows.
cases.approach: unit-testable - spinner state is false and the overlay is gone after a failed fetch, with the dialog shown

cases.desc: Verify Home renders with no network.
cases.expected: Home renders fully; only API-backed actions degrade.
cases.approach: unit-testable - with token and version rejecting offline, Home renders all seven buttons and the illustration, shows no error and Offers still navigates

cases.desc: Verify FAQs with no network shows error.
cases.expected: Error dialog shows; spinner clears.
cases.approach: unit-testable - a Network Error on the FAQ call shows the exact error dialog and clears the spinner

cases.desc: Verify Pay Now with no network shows WebView error.
cases.expected: WebView error state shows; user can go back to Home.
cases.approach: unit-testable - divergent: case expects a WebView error state with no network; spec decision: no WebView, Pay Now still opens with no network content (FR-014, N-10)

cases.desc: Verify network lost mid FAQ fetch.
cases.expected: Request fails; spinner clears; error dialog shows.
cases.approach: unit-testable - a request that fails after the spinner shows clears the spinner, shows the dialog and does not navigate

cases.desc: Verify rapid taps on different tiles open one destination.
cases.expected: Only one destination opens; no duplicate stack entries.
cases.approach: unit-testable - rapid taps on Offers, Our Products and Login produce a single navigate call

cases.desc: Verify rapid taps on the same tile do not duplicate screens.
cases.expected: Offers opens once; back returns to Home in one step.
cases.approach: unit-testable - two presses of the same tile navigate once (one stack entry) until focus returns

cases.desc: Verify layout on small screen 320 x 568.
cases.expected: Content scrolls; Login reachable; nothing clipped.
cases.approach: unit-testable - partial: at 320 x 568 Login is inside the ScrollView content, the indicator is hidden and the content container has no fixed height; manual remainder: a person confirms nothing is clipped and Login is reachable on a real small device

cases.desc: Verify layout on tablet or wide screen.
cases.expected: Content is centred and tiles are not stretched (BRD O-13 pending).
cases.approach: out-of-scope - tablet / wide-screen layout rules are an open BRD item (O-13, FR-008); nothing to test until Design decides

cases.desc: Verify cold start time to interactive.
cases.expected: Within the agreed target (BRD PERF-1, pending).
cases.approach: manual - cold-start time to interactive (PERF-1, 2 s, owner-set) is device timing on a mid-range device; no unit test can measure it

cases.desc: Verify no memory growth when opening and closing tiles repeatedly.
cases.expected: Memory stays stable; no crash.
cases.approach: unit-testable - partial: after 50 mount and unmount cycles every back and navigation listener added is removed; manual remainder: a person profiles memory over repeated open and close on a device

cases.desc: Verify Android and iOS parity.
cases.expected: Same layout and flows, except hardware back and Exit button (Android only).
cases.approach: manual - Android and iOS layout and flow parity needs both platforms on real devices; unit tests only fake Platform.OS
